第11章 怎么撮合都没用（第1页）
林芜和封庭深是在她和封庭深结婚之后才认识的。
林芜知道她和封庭深的关系，她不相信林立海不知道封庭深是他另外一个女儿的丈夫！
可他依旧恬不知耻的在撮合林芜和封庭深。
可见在林立海心里，他对她这个女儿漠视得到底有多彻底！
他们又寒暄了几句，容辞看着封庭深在等林立海上车，并车子开走了之后，才上车离开。
以封庭深如今的身份地位，能让他做到这个份上的，通常只有封家零星几位长辈。
想到这，她想起封庭深见她的外婆和舅舅舅妈那几次，他都是比较漠视冷淡的态度。
而且，过去她就算小心翼翼地跟他提及，他却怎么也不愿意帮一下她舅舅的忙……
可他对林芜重视的人，可不是这样的态度。
他对她与他对林芜，简直是天差地别。
下午，容辞下班后，回家取了她之前给封家老太太和老爷子准备好的礼物，才开车前往封家老宅。
封家老宅临近都城郊区，那边山清水秀，环境清静，非常合适老人居住。
容辞开了一个半小时的车才抵达老宅。
她停好车，提着礼物还没进屋就听到了女儿封景心欢快的笑声。
封老太太面向门口，第一时间就注意到了她，立刻笑了开来：“小辞来啦？快，快过来奶奶这里坐。”
可有只有封老太太是笑着的，封庭深的母亲，也就是她的婆婆，还有封庭琳母子看到她时，脸上的笑容就都淡了下来。
容辞注意到了，但已经不似以前那样在意了。

她当没看到，笑了笑，把带过来的礼物交给迎上来的管家后，朝老太太走了过去：“奶奶。”
“哎。”老太太乐开了花，拉着容辞坐下，随即也皱了眉头：“怎么瘦了这么多？是不是庭深欺负你了？”
容辞垂眸，摇头：“没有，就是最近比较忙。”
封庭深没欺负她，但她的心情确实经常因为他而受到影响。
除此之外，这半个月里，她每天下班之后，基本上都会专注于研究人工智能，且经常研究到凌晨才睡。
老太太来不及说话，封庭琳就先嗤笑出声了：“你这话说的，不知道的人还以为你的工作到底有多么重要，整个封氏集团都离不开你一样。”
封庭深的母亲桑倩坐在一旁，尽显优雅贵妇气派。
她抿了一口茶，冷淡地说道：“要觉得在封氏集团的工作累，干脆辞职好了，毕竟，没人求着你到封氏集团工作。”
封庭琳笑：“可不是么！只怕有人舍不得——”
老太太看不得其他人说容辞，正要说话，可容辞比她先一步开口：“我已经提交了辞呈，做好交接工作，我就会离开封氏。”
此言一出，桑倩和封庭琳都愣了下。

Chapter 11 No matter how you match up, it’s useless (Page 1)
Lin Wu and Feng Tingshen only met after she married Feng Tingshen.
Lin Wu knew about her relationship with Feng Tingshen, but she didn't believe that Lin Lihai didn't know that Feng Tingshen was the husband of his other daughter!
But he was still shamelessly trying to bring Lin Wu and Feng Tingshen together.
It can be seen that in Lin Lihai's heart, he completely ignored her as a daughter!
They exchanged some more pleasantries, and Rong Ci watched Feng Tingshen wait for Lin Lihai to get in the car and drive away before getting in the car and leaving.
With Feng Tingshen's current status, there are usually only a few elders of the Feng family who can do this.
Thinking of this, she recalled that the few times Feng Ting met her grandmother, uncle and aunt, he had always had a relatively indifferent attitude.
Moreover, even if she mentioned it to him carefully in the past, he was still unwilling to help her uncle...
But he didn't have such an attitude toward the people Lin Wu valued.
There was a world of difference between him treating her and Lin Wu.
In the afternoon, after Rong Ci got off work, she went home to pick up the gifts she had prepared for the old lady and the old man of the Feng family before driving to the old house of the Feng family.
The old house of the Feng family is close to the outskirts of the capital city. It has beautiful mountains and clear waters and a quiet environment, which is very suitable for the elderly to live.
Rong Ci drove for an hour and a half before arriving at the old house.
She parked the car and heard her daughter Feng Jingxin's cheerful laughter before she even entered the house with the gifts.
Old Mrs. Feng faced the door. She noticed her immediately and immediately smiled: "Xiao Ci is here? Come on, come and sit here with grandma."
But only Mrs. Feng was smiling. When Feng Tingshen's mother, her mother-in-law, and Feng Tinglin's mother and son saw her, the smiles on their faces faded.
Rong Ci noticed it, but he no longer cared as much as before.
She pretended she didn't see it, smiled, handed the gift to the housekeeper who came up, and walked towards the old lady: "Grandma."
"Hey." The old lady was happy and pulled Rong Ci to sit down. Then she frowned: "Why have you lost so much weight? Did Ting Shen bully you?"
Rong Ci lowered his eyes and shook his head: "No, I'm just busy lately."
Feng Tingshen didn't bully her, but her mood was often affected by him.
In addition, during the past half month, after getting off work every day, she basically focused on studying artificial intelligence, and often did not sleep until the early morning.
Before the old lady had time to speak, Feng Tinglin sneered: "What you said makes people who don't know how important your work really is, as if the entire Feng Group cannot do without you."
Feng Tingshen's mother Sang Qian sat aside, showing off the air of an elegant lady.
She took a sip of tea and said coldly: "If you feel tired from working in Fengshi Group, just resign. After all, no one is begging you to work in Fengshi Group."
Feng Tinglin smiled: "That's right! I'm afraid some people won't be able to let go -"
The old lady couldn't see others talking about Rong Ci. She was about to speak, but Rong Ci spoke before her: "I have submitted my resignation. If the handover is completed, I will leave the Feng family."
As soon as these words came out, Sang Qian and Feng Tinglin were stunned for a moment.
